paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yevamot 98a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.98a.4): R' Yose reported an incident in which Nifetayim the convert married his maternal brother’s wife.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked baraita names Nifetayim and describes the relationship as his brother through his mother.
Rabbi Yose reports the case. Hyman excerpts its opening, before the Gemara discusses how to understand the ruling.
